summary.text: Hector Rivera is the Republican candidate for Florida State Senate District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Lauren Book in a race with no incumbent.
A real estate and mortgage broker, he won the August 18, 2026 Republican primary over Jerusa Zitta with 61.3 percent of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Hector Rivera earned a GED and has worked as a real estate broker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has spent 38 years as a real estate and mortgage broker.

He said his priorities include insurance relief through policyholder-owned reciprocal exchanges, property tax relief through expanded homestead savings, school safety measures, low-rate financing for condo and homeowners association costs, and home rule.
